人们的日子越来越不好过。.py: rén men de rì zi yuè lái yuè bù hǎo guò
人们的日子越来越不好过。.enContext: Life grew harder and harder, and many people could not get enough to eat.

他们来到中国。.enContext: They came to China and fought several wars, and the Qing lost every one.

清朝都输了。.enContext: They came to China and fought several wars, and the Qing lost every one.

newWords.en: life (as the characteristic of living beings)

reviewWords.en: the scene (of a crime, accident etc)

他相信中国人自己可以做到。.py: tā xiāng xìn Zhōngguó rén zì jǐ kě yǐ zuò dào
他相信中国人自己可以做到。.en: He believed the Chinese people could do it themselves.

他们想让自己的国家好起来。.py: tā men xiǎng ràng zì jǐ de guó jiā hǎo qǐ lái
他们想让自己的国家好起来。.en: They wanted to make their country better.

国家里面有问题。.py: guó jiā lǐ miàn yǒu wèn tí
国家里面有问题。.enContext: But life in those days was very hard, with trouble inside the country and outside it.

中国要不一样。.enContext: Many thought: China must be different.

他们上的是新式的学校。.py: tā men shàng de shì xīn shì de xué xiào
他们上的是新式的学校。.enContext: These attended new-style schools that taught mathematics and western science.

学校里教数学。.enContext: These attended new-style schools that taught mathematics and western science.
